ABOUT ARKISTA'S RING (NES)

Arkista's Ring is an extremely pleasant action/adventure game featuring cute enemies, soothing music and an elf girl as the main character. The 125 stages are chock-full of weapon power-ups and other useful items, and each mission is very straightforward. The gameplay depth may pale in comparison to The Legend of Zelda, but Arkista's Ring could serve as the perfect beginner's guide to action RPGs.  Brett Alan Weiss, All Game Guide
